verdict.rationale: SumUp's Cloud API documentation lists pairing multiple Solo readers to an account and naming each reader, which covers device registration and light configuration for a multi-reader fleet. Nothing in the pack shows API endpoints for monitoring reader status or pushing broader configuration remotely. Missing for 10: documented device-status or health monitoring API, remote configuration or update endpoints beyond naming, explicit API reference for reader registration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage a fleet of readers and terminals via API — register devices, monitor status, and update configuration remotely

citations.quote: Pairing multiple Solo card readers with any SumUp account
Naming each Solo card reader as desired to streamline checkout
Ability to process simultaneous transactions on multiple Solo card readers at once
Use Virtual Solo together with a sandbox merchant account to test the pairing and checkout flow first, then switch to a physical reader later
